premises.text: Language learning today is time-intensive, dull, and disconnected from the learner's life
premises.evidence_span: It's time intensive, it's dull, and it lacks any relevant connection to your life

premises.text: Turning topical content learners already consume into three-minute educational modules served on SMS, mobile, and web makes classrooms ubiquitous
premises.evidence_span: First, we take topical content that you're actually reading anyway, and we convert it into educational program. These are your new textbooks. Then, we take that, break it into three-minute, very small, bite-sized modules, and we serve it to you everywhere

premises.text: Adaptive personalized pedagogy uses L1 support, required output, scaffolding, and skill-level passages
premises.evidence_span: Voxy's adaptive, synchronous, and personalized language curriculum

premises.text: Streaks, words, and points game mechanics motivate consistency, mastery, and interactive practice
premises.evidence_span: we use streaks, words, and points for that

premises.text: Compelling unit economics: ~$1 student acquisition with low-cost leadership and strong willingness to pay
premises.evidence_span: the unit economics are quite compelling

value.text: Teach languages from the learner's life with a solution that integrates seamlessly into daily routines
value.evidence_span: an innovative language learning solution that integrates seamlessly into your life

secondary_value.text: Scale beyond English launch into other languages
secondary_value.evidence_span: we're launching in English, but very soon we're scaling to other languages

causal_links.evidence_span: But Voxy's going to change that
there's a lot of willingness to pay
